resolutions.resolution_route_used: UniProt F6RNY4 Noggin chain (repo) vs Xenopus organizer/Noggin literature via Xenbase-linked sources (OpenAlex)
resolutions.evidence: Noggin is an organizer-secreted BMP-binding dorsalizer in Xenopus: endoderm/dorsal induction by organizer-secreted chordin and noggin demonstrated in animal caps (1996, doi:10.1002/j.1460-2075.1996.tb00832.x), and neural induction via Chordin/Noggin BMP antagonism (doi:10.1371/journal.pbio.0020092). Gain->dorsalization/secondary axis, loss->ventralization is the canonical direction, matching the registered prediction (evidence primarily X. laevis, applied to the tropicalis ortholog).

resolutions.resolution_route_used: Live UniProt REST query for reviewed Xenopus shh entries (organism_id 8364 tropicalis, 8355 laevis) on 2026-10-26
resolutions.evidence: Reviewed X. tropicalis shh hits: 0 (the repo's A0A803JKD3 remains unreviewed, no lipidation annotated — as registered). Reviewed X. laevis Q92000 (SHH_XENLA) retrieved live: chain 25-444, N-product chain 25-198, Lipidation N-palmitoyl cysteine at 25 and Cholesterol glycine ester at 198 (evidence ECO:0000250, by similarity to mouse Q62226). Dual lipidation is therefore confirmed in a reviewed Xenopus entry (laevis, by-similarity annotation), exactly the registered conservation prediction, with the tropicalis-specific experimental annotation still outstanding.
resolutions.resolvability_verdict: as_predicted — current_plus_public_sources (conf 0.75): one reviewed-entry lookup decided it; caveat that the lipidation evidence is by-similarity, noted for the merge.

resolutions.resolution_route_used: Dataset law S=u*T vs Xenopus hes/somitogenesis literature search (OpenAlex)
resolutions.evidence: Bound established: Xenopus somitogenesis uses a her/hes segmentation clock with a wavefront, so the proportional S~T architecture is the applicable framework (cross-species replication target of ZF-CLK-01). NOT established: paired Xenopus period-manipulation + somite-length measurements sufficient to test the x0.80-x1.20 multipliers within 5 points. Missing data: paired clock-period and somite-length series under controlled wavefront conditions in Xenopus.
resolutions.resolvability_verdict: as_predicted — registered partial_only (conf 0.50), mirroring ZF-CLK-01 as forecast.

notes: 2 confirmed, 1 partial as forecast. XT-SHH-01 carries a by-similarity evidence caveat (X. laevis reviewed entry; no reviewed X. tropicalis entry exists yet). XT-DQ-01 was resolved in the inrepo-quick batch, not here.
